app.name: Image Batch Studio
app.tagline: Professional image processing. No subscriptions. No cloud.

modules.converter: Convert images between PNG, JPG, WebP, AVIF, BMP, TIFF, GIF and ICO.
modules.compressor: Reduce file size in bulk while keeping the quality you choose.
modules.resizer: Resize by pixels, percentage or platform presets.
modules.watermark: Add text or logo watermarks to entire batches.
modules.renamer: Rename hundreds of files with templates and numbering.
modules.metadata: Inspect and remove EXIF, GPS and other metadata.
modules.cropRotate: Crop, rotate and flip images in batch.
modules.analyzer: Inspect dimensions, formats, transparency and potential savings.
modules.unavailableTitle: This module is not available yet
modules.unavailableBody: It is being built and will be enabled in an upcoming version.
modules.pipeline: Chain crop, resize, watermark, rename and conversion in one batch.
